name.value: Olive Us Olive Oil and Vinegar Tasting Room

description.value: Olive Us Oils is an independent, family-owned specialty tasting room that opened in Vernon in 2013, offering complimentary samples of ultra-premium extra virgin olive oils and aged balsamic vinegars in a warm, urban-rustic setting. The shop stocks a curated range of gourmet products including flavoured olive oils, artisan vinegars, sea salts, pasta, and charcuterie, alongside gift baskets and specialty items. Owners Ray Morin and Janet Cody built the business around a passion for sharing the culinary and health potential of fresh-crushed EVOO and fine aged vinegars.
